Hi, welcome to Pediatric Physical Therapy (Pediatric Home PT), a channel designed by a licensed Physical Therapist, Doctor of Physical Therapy, and Certified Lymphedema Therapist. We try to provide the best pediatric physical therapy videos and show students, children and teens how to stretch, exercise, relieve pain, and perform pressure relief. I give tips on how to build and improve gross motor skills at home, during homeschooling, or in the classroom setting.

Have fun, be safe, stay healthy, and get strong while we #stayhome #homeschool2020
